categoryDescriptions.ORDER_STATUS: Changes or cancellations before an order ships, and orders that have not shipped yet.
categoryDescriptions.DELIVERY: Tracking, and parcels that are late, lost or delivered to the wrong place after shipping.
categoryDescriptions.PAYMENT: A failed, double or wrong payment at checkout.
categoryDescriptions.PRODUCT_ISSUE: An item that arrived broken, faulty, wrong, missing from the box or not as described.
categoryDescriptions.GENERAL: Questions, feedback and anything that fits no other category.

policies.guidance: Check the carrier's proof of delivery (photo or GPS) and the address; within 48 hours of the delivered scan, ask the customer to check nearby, then open a claim.
Ask for a photo of the damage and offer a replacement or a refund under the returns policy.
Confirm the return was received; if the refund has not reached the customer, trace it with the payment provider and share the refund reference.
Check the payment processor first: refund a second capture at once; if it is only a pending authorization, explain that it drops off within 5 days.
Change the address only before the order ships; after that, ask the carrier to redirect it.
Check for a locked account or an order placed as a guest before sending another reset; verify the account email and never ask for the password.

ORDER_STATUS: Check whether the order has shipped
Update the order only before it ships
DELIVERY: Open a carrier claim when tracking shows no progress
RETURN_REFUND: Check that the return was received
Confirm the refund date and method
PAYMENT: Compare the order with the payment records
Explain when a pending duplicate drops off
PRODUCT_ISSUE: Ask for a photo of the item
Offer a replacement or a refund
ACCOUNT_ACCESS: Check for a locked account or a guest order
Verify the account email, never ask for the password
GENERAL: Respond with the next supported step

SERVICE_BLOCKED.explanation: The customer cannot pay or sign in
